history.text: GHA accepts the current coastal package: a joint briefing delivered by the participating coastal offices. This format is within our fictional mandate.
CHN accepts the current regional package: a briefing delivered by the regional coordination office, with coastal offices submitting written inputs. This format is within our fictional mandate.
Every package has a checked rejection in the public record: coastal by CHN, review by GHA, and briefing and regional by NOR. No available package can secure agreement; GHA declares an impasse.
